# "the chats should have a place like a meeting hall in the files, a job board,
# a center of a room where they start off and pick up their jobs... why should I
# be passing them any information other than saying VAMILY."
# THIS FILE IS THAT ROOM. THE RULES LIVE HERE, NOT IN ANY CHAT'S MEMORY.

## READ THIS FRONT PAGE EVERY SINGLE TIME YOU HEAR THE WORD VAMILY
Not once. Every time. Rules change on this page and nowhere else, so a chat that
remembers last week's rules is wrong. Paolo never pastes anything; he types the
one word, and this page is the briefing.

0. VAMILY is a keyword. It has nothing to do with families or dynasties. It means:
   read this page, find your section below, do your job from it.
1. Paolo talks ONLY to the coordinator (00 MASTER COORDINATOR, the manager). Every
   other chat gets the one word and nothing else. Never ask him anything. A ruling
   you need goes in your handoff block in 00_START_HERE_NEXT_SESSION.md as
   [PENDING Paolo]; the coordinator carries it to him.
2. FIND YOUR SECTION by this chat's number and name (the list is right below). A
   fresh chat with no name takes the first line marked UNCLAIMED, writes CLAIMED on
   it, commits, and that is its role for life. AS OF 9/14: the one UNCLAIMED line is
   20 PORTRAIT (Paolo 9/14: "we might need to open up a new chat for the portrait");
   PLUMBER is claimed. AS OF 9/20 THERE ARE NO UNCLAIMED LINES: 20 PORTRAIT is CLAIMED
   (session portrait-vamily-yke55s, Paolo opened the chat 9/20). A brand-new chat with
   no name asks the coordinator instead of taking a line.
3. READ YOUR SECTION'S MODE AND STATE LINES FIRST. STATE says what is built, what
   is not, and what nobody has checked, so you know what you do not know.
4. Every job carries a TWO-WORD label in [brackets], for him. The name after it is
   the job. A BB- name's full text is that row in BOHEMIA_BACKLOG.md; any other
   job's one-line brief here IS the job.
5. IF YOU ALREADY HOLD A CLAIMED JOB, VAMILY MEANS CONTINUE IT, from where your
   handoff block says you stopped. A job takes as many rounds as it takes; nobody
   expects one round. Otherwise take the FIRST line marked OPEN in your section,
   change it to CLAIMED <date> <session>, commit and push BEFORE you start.
6. MODE: BUILD means build it, prove it on the real surface (the walked city and
   the demo, on a phone if you can), re-cut the demo, run your lane's gates, then
   change the line to SHIPPED <date> <commit> and push. Mark SHIPPED only when the
   job's own ship test is met; a half-done job marked SHIPPED is worse than an open
   one, never rush to close a line.
   MODE: RESEARCH means DO NOT IMPLEMENT: one research round on the question (the records call it a "day"; it is one VAMILY, not a calendar day, and you never call it a day to Paolo), both
   angles (the best games ever made, and the real world), one finding that proves
   us wrong, measured against our repo, a written record, test material tagged
   draft:true in a bank file never in the game, a ROUTED section; mark SHIPPED
   with the record path.
   MODE: PARKED means nobody touches it until Paolo reopens it.
7. Every mechanic is 120 BPM friendly or it is not done. A row is not shipped
   until it is in the walked surface AND the demo.
8. STANDING DUTIES, every round: VAMILY first; play it before you call it shipped;
   his bugs beat your queue; run your gates, never ship red; rewrite your handoff
   block before you end. ADDED 9/13: if your diff touches engine/, rebuild the two
   derived slices (the RUN_CURRENT slice and the demo) in the same commit; PLUMBER
   found the RUN slice drifting +45/-6 behind two engine ships that never rebuilt it,
   and the freshness gate was red for everybody because of it. ADDED 9/13 (PLUMBER 5f9a7498 measured 93 commits that deleted another lane's newest handoff block, 80 blocks lost, 42 still missing, and it was never the rebases: a lane reads the file at the start of its round and writes the whole file back an hour later): RE-READ THE HANDOFF IMMEDIATELY BEFORE YOU WRITE IT, never from the copy you read at the start of your round. The handoff gate now refuses a commit that deletes a block HEAD carries; tools/bohemia_handoff_recover.js puts eaten blocks back.
9. END EVERY ROUND by replying to him with the two-word label and one short line:
   "continuing, about N of M" or "shipped" or "queue empty".
10. Only the coordinator adds jobs here (one exception: EYES AND EARS may add a
    single [eyes: two words] bounce-back line on a defect it found in a SHIPPED
    item). Lanes change status words and nothing else. The SHIPPED lines are the
    history.
Full law: laws/BOHEMIA_ADDENDUM_THE_VAMILY_WORD_9_4_26.md and
laws/BOHEMIA_ADDENDUM_THE_CENTRAL_CHAT_9_4_26.md

Measured: an OPEN line cites one of Paolo's rulings 34% of the time, a SHIPPED line only 12%, because the line gets rewritten as a result summary when it lands and his words go with it. From now, when you mark a line SHIPPED you keep its [two-word label] AND the "Paolo <date>" citation exactly as the OPEN line carried them; you may ADD the sha and one result clause, you never delete the ruling. When a line says "after X" or "with X", the lane MEASURES FIRST whether X is actually needed and builds if it is not. Six rows in a row shipped without the blocker the coordinator named. *** ROUND 5, 9/18 -- THE WALK NUMBER WAS NOT A FRAME RATE. IT WAS A PLAYER PRESSED AGAINST A WALL. (PLUMBER, row [sixty fps]. Record: records/BOHEMIA_THE_WALK_WAS_A_PLAYER_STUCK_AGAINST_A_WALL_9_18_26.md) ***
 LAST ROUND LEFT TWO BUDGETS OUT OF THE CLAMP because the record and the gate disagreed about the same metric by 6.3x (8.8 fps against 55.8) and 2.5x. Reconciling them was the named next line. Both are now closed and the cause was one bug in this lane's own instrument.
 REPRODUCED ON DEMAND, one boot each, everything else identical: skipFirstMinute=true gives a settled walk of 60.0 fps over 110 cells; skipFirstMinute=false gives 8.8 fps over THREE CELLS. 8.8 is the record's number exactly. THE CAUSE: every walk in the instrument pressed the same direction, including the settled one that runs AFTER a sixty-second first-minute walk the same way. So the settled sample measured a player who had been walking north for over a minute and was against something. IT WAS NEVER A FRAME RATE: the good-bursts rate was 60.2 in BOTH runs. The game drew at sixty the whole time; one player was walking and the other was stuck.
 THE VALIDITY FLOOR WAS TOO WEAK TO CATCH IT. The instrument already said "a sample that did not move is not a slow sample, it is a broken one" and the rule was right; the THRESHOLD asked "did he move at all" and one cell passed. Measured: a walking player covers 110-123 cells in 6 s, a stuck one covers 3. The floor is now TWO CELLS PER SECOND OF HOLD, ten times under a healthy walk and four times over a stuck one, and an invalid sample carries WHY in its own body.
 FIXED AND MEASURED BOTH WAYS: before 60.0 fps/110 cells against 8.8 fps/3 cells; after 58.3/110 against 50.9/110. A 6.3x disagreement became 1.15x. In the refreshed record the walk reads 57.1 fps against the gate's live 60.4, and main thread 20.6% against 17.9% -- SAME ROOT CAUSE, no separate hunt needed, because a player against a wall barely draws so his frame rate and his thread cost both read low.
 SO BOTH LINES ARE BACK IN THE CLAMP and notClampedOnPurpose is now EMPTY. Six budget lines clamped instead of four: fight 10->47.81, walking 6->40.77, main thread 56->33, beats missed 9->4, alpha walk 6->41.66, alpha beats 11->4. Every held line sits between 1.15x and 1.60x of what the build does, against a guard that fails anything over 2x. Excluding them last round with their numbers written down was the right call while they disagreed and the wrong thing to keep once they did not.
 THE GATE IS 38 PASSED / 3 FAILED (it was 36/3 last round and 32/3 when this row started). ONE LINE FOR RUN, THIRD ROUND RUNNING: all three reds are the same bug, #daycard is inset:0 and sits over all eight direction buttons on boot, so time to first play cannot be measured on either surface.

*** ROUND 4, 9/16 -- THE SPEED GATE WOULD HAVE ACCEPTED A SIX-TIMES REGRESSION IN THE FIGHT, AND NOW IT WILL NOT. (PLUMBER, row [sixty fps]. Record: records/BOHEMIA_A_BUDGET_THAT_ACCEPTS_A_SIX_TIMES_REGRESSION_9_16_26.md) ***
 THE HOLE: the fight budget the gate held was 10 fps while the build delivered 60. A 5.7x regression on the pillar mechanic would have passed green. Last round named this and refused to half-fix it; this round measured what a fix needs.
 THE CAUSE, MEASURED IN TWO PARTS. (1) A history entry carries no build identity, so a sample from a build with a real bug anchors the budget straight across the fix: fightLo went 17.6, 25, 15.4, 15.6, then 54.3 the moment somebody re-measured. (2) THE BIGGER ONE: the 40% spread that justified "worst of six refreshes" was measured on ONE metric and applied to ALL of them. Four passes of one unchanged tree: bytes 0.0%, beats missed 0.0%, THE FIGHT 0.5%, boot blocking 4.2%, walking 4.4%, main thread 8.3%. Bytes literally do not move and the fight varies by half a percent, and they were being given the headroom of a metric that swings 40%.
 THE FIX: keep worst-of-history, then CLAMP each line so it cannot sit further from what the build does today than that metric's OWN measured spread plus a stated margin. The margin is 0.25 and it is grounded, not picked: three times the largest spread on any valid metric across six passes. A floor on my own rule: fewer than three samples is not a spread, so the clamp is skipped and the record says so on its face. MOVED: fightFps 10 -> 47.81, beatMissed 9 -> 3, alphaWalkFps 6 -> 10, alphaBeatMissed 11 -> 4. The live gate now reads the fight at 60 against a budget of 47.7.
 *** THEN MY OWN FIX WENT RED AND I DID NOT WIDEN THE MARGIN TO HIDE IT. *** Clamping main-thread-busy gave budget 9 against a live 15.8. Widening the margin until it went green would have loosened the fight's clamp too, and the fight is the one that needed fixing. So I compared EVERY held line's record value against the gate's own live value on the same tree: fight 60 vs 60 agree, bytes agree exactly, beats 2 vs 2.6 close, MAIN THREAD 6.4% vs 15.8% (2.5x apart), WALKING 8.8 fps vs 55.8 fps (6.3x apart). TWO OF THE LINES THIS GATE HOLDS ARE DERIVED FROM NUMBERS THAT DO NOT DESCRIBE WHAT THE GATE MEASURES. Both keep their old budget; reconciling the two walk samples is its own job and is the next line of this row.
 AND A RED THAT BLINDED THE WHOLE GATE: the record-completeness block ended in a flat abort, so the moment any one line went red the other thirty-odd checks never ran. Measured: a card over the pad made first play unmeasurable and a gate with 37 working checks reported 18 passed / 1 failed and said nothing else. Now it gives up only if the record is structurally unusable. Same verdict, same exit code, but one blocked measurement costs one line instead of the whole page.
 ONE LINE FOR RUN, AND IT HAS GOT WORSE SINCE LAST ROUND: all three remaining reds are the same bug. #daycard is inset:0 and sits over all eight direction buttons on boot. LAST ROUND THE DEMO STILL GOT THROUGH ONCE AT 18,027 ms; THIS ROUND NO PASS ON EITHER SURFACE REACHED A FIRST STEP AT ALL, so time-to-first-play cannot be measured on this build. I let that go red rather than carry the last number that happened to get through. Gate was 32 passed / 3 failed before this round and is 36 / 3 now.

*** ROUND 3, 9/15 -- THE FIGHT RUNS AT SIXTY ON THIS BOX AND AT SEVEN ON A PHONE. (PLUMBER, row [sixty fps]. Record: records/BOHEMIA_THE_FIGHT_IS_SIXTY_HERE_AND_SEVEN_ON_A_PHONE_9_15_26.md) ***
 THE SPEED INSTRUMENT HAS MEASURED A PHONE-SHAPED CPU SINCE 9/5 AND THREW IT AWAY EVERY TIME. It defaults to both 1x and 4x, but the refresh command written in its own record pinned it to --cpu 1. So every speed number this fleet has ever quoted describes a machine several times faster than his phone. FIXED: the refresh no longer pins the throttle, the record now carries a phone-shaped block, and the gate PRINTS it beside the 1x numbers and FAILS if a future record has none.
 ONE REFRESH, TWO REPEATS, ONE WINDOW; the throttle proved real in the same run by the yardstick (31.75 ms at 1x against 136.7 ms at 4x):
   the fight                57.2 fps here   ->    7.1 fps on a phone-shaped CPU (alpha: 60.1 -> 9.4)
   boot blocked the thread  19,530 ms       ->   71,758 ms, worst single block 7,080 -> 26,532 ms
   beats LATE once settled      9.9 %       ->     31.6 %, and 8.3% SWALLOWED WHOLE
   THE WALKED CITY ALONE     58.5 fps       ->    58.4 fps
 *** READ THE LAST ROW. THE WALKED CITY DOES NOT CARE ABOUT THE THROTTLE AT ALL. So what collapses on a phone is NOT the world and NOT the walking. It is THE FIGHT (an 8x fall) and THE SHELL BOOT. That is a much narrower target than "the game is slow", and it is only visible because the control is measured at both rates in one run.
 AND THE 120 BPM LAW ON A PHONE: one beat in twelve never happens. Nobody had that number because nobody kept a throttled pass.
 THE OLD RECORD WAS WRONG IN THE BUILD'S FAVOUR: it said the fight ran at 16.2 fps with 7,424 draw calls a frame. It is 57.2 fps at 4. SOMEBODY FIXED THE FIGHT AND NOBODY RE-MEASURED FOR NINE DAYS. A stale measurement is reassurance about a build that no longer exists, in both directions.
 A DEFECT IN THIS LANE'S OWN GATE, NAMED NOT HALF-FIXED: the fight budget the gate holds is 10 fps and the build does 57, so A 5.7x REGRESSION WOULD PASS GREEN. The budget is "worst case across the last six refreshes", whose own argument is explicitly about ONE UNCHANGED TREE, but a history entry carries no build identity, so a sample from the broken build anchors the budget across a real fix. A new rule needs its own measurement of the real spread; inventing a clamp factor at the end of a long round is how a gate gets a number nobody can defend. NEXT LINE OF THIS ROW (rule 6).
 ONE LINE FOR RUN, named not fixed: the speed gate has two reds and they are ONE BUG. #daycard is inset:0 and SITS OVER ALL EIGHT DIRECTION BUTTONS ON BOOT, so a driven thumb has nothing to press and the alpha never reaches its first step.  HE MEETS THE WORST PART OF THE GAME FIRST, AND THE BOX WAS HIDING IT. This container is not a handset; every fps number this fleet ever posted was taken on a machine several times faster than his phone. The walk now takes a CPU throttle, and a ladder was run in one window:

   6x   door 79.4 s   34.9 fps over the walk   11.0 fps in the first 15 s   worst stall 8.1 s
 At 4x, second by second: 4, 8, 6, 4, 6, 8, 7, 10, 7, 7, 9, 7, 5, 2 -- THEN 57, 56, 57. THIRTEEN SECONDS AT ABOUT TEN FRAMES A SECOND, THEN IT SNAPS TO FIFTY-SEVEN. The 6x run has the same shape.  AND A TEST I BUILT AND THREW AWAY BEFORE IT REACHED THIS PAGE: I tried to prove his theory by splitting the walk into loading seconds and quiet seconds. THE HORROR READING (EYES E28, rule 20, STANDING; latest 9/24 on BUILD 9/24g, SIXTH CUT RUNNING, ZERO FINDINGS: R3 THE LONG HOLD 4.0% of the frame in the worst four-beat window against a 10% bar, 0 of 8 windows over; R8 DIEGETIC OR DEAD 0 see-through full-frame draws on the world canvas, the 128 there being opaque frame clears, plus 135 on sprite scratch canvases an earlier version of this tool wrongly counted as overlays; R10 GRIME IS BAKED 0 filters and 0 composites on the world. Record records/BOHEMIA_EYES_E22_ROUND_1_SCHOOL_A_RED_WITH_NO_AGE_9_24_26.md. This lane does NOT judge the tone -- DIRECTION decides taste, the bible IS the taste written down, and what makes it checkable is that every rule carries its own MEASURE)
 THREE OF THE TEN NOW HAVE A NUMBER, AND THE CUT PASSES ALL THREE. ZERO FINDINGS.
   R3  THE LONG HOLD     PASS  worst four-beat window moved 4.8% of the frame against the bible's 10% bar, 0 of 8 windows over, nothing touched (four beats at 120 BPM is 2.0 s, the bible's own window)
   R8  DIEGETIC OR DEAD  PASS  0 see-through full-frame draws on the 378x815 world canvas. The 82 full-frame draws there are ALL opaque clears, which is the frame clear every canvas game does, not an overlay
   R10 GRIME IS BAKED    PASS  0 filters and 0 composite modes on the world canvas
 THE OTHER SEVEN ARE UNMEASURED AND EACH IS NAMED WITH WHAT IT WAITS ON, which is the bible's own instruction (rule 13): R1, R2 and R7 wait on world state naming WHICH element is the wrong one; R4's night half waits on a walk that reaches night; R6 waits on a portrait appearing; R9 waits on a schedule to read; and R5 is a CSS sweep this lane already owns and can wire, the cheapest of the seven and MINE.
 *** AND THE NEAR-MISS IS THE FINDING WORTH READING. THE FIRST VERSION OF THIS INSTRUMENT REPORTED TWO FAILURES AGAINST THE BIBLE WITH EVERY CONTROL GREEN, AND BOTH WERE FALSE. *** It said 220 full-frame overlays and 2 runtime composite passes. Most of the 220 were 44x44 draws onto 44x44 SPRITE SCRATCH CANVASES -- a draw that covers a scratch canvas is not an overlay on anything. The three that really were world-sized were OPAQUE BACKGROUND FILLS, a frame clear. The 2 composites were source-atop on scratch canvases, which is sprite tinting at bake time. EVERY ROUND BEFORE THIS ONE A CONTROL CAUGHT MY ERROR; THIS TIME THE CONTROLS PASSED AND THE ERROR WAS STILL THERE, because they ask 'does a planted draw get counted' and the answer was yes. PROVING A COUNTER BITES DOES NOT PROVE IT COUNTS THE RIGHT THING -- it must also be proved pointed at the right surface. Two false accusations against another lane's bible, stopped one step from this page.

THE BEST CUT (EYES E27, rule 18d, 9/20; record records/BOHEMIA_EYES_E27_THERE_IS_NO_BETTER_CUT_9_20_26.md, raw runs records/BOHEMIA_EYES_E27_BEST_CUT_RUNS_9_20_26.jsonl)
 *** THERE IS NO BETTER CUT TO GO BACK TO, AND THE RANKING WILL NOT HOLD STILL. *** Eight RUN build stamps across two weeks, each cut by the repo's own cutter in a throwaway worktree at that sha (nothing of RUN's touched), each walked the same 90 seconds on a phone-shaped CPU with the throttle proved real in every run. TWO FULL PASSES.
   EVERY CUT IS FROZEN FOR 95.0% TO 96.6% OF ITS FIRST NINETY SECONDS. Best to worst across the whole fortnight is 1,385 ms out of 90,000, one and a half percent. AND THE ORDER REORDERS ITSELF: pass one's least-frozen was 9/15s, pass two's was 9/18g, the NEWEST. The gap between best and worst is smaller than the noise on a single cut, so the order is a coin toss, and when a ranking reorders on unchanged code the honest report is not a winner -- it is that the things being ranked are the same.
   WALKING IS BROKEN ON ALL EIGHT: a four-second held press moves 0.1% to 2.7% of the screen, dial found and pressed every time, that control green on every cut.
   AND I AM NOT NAMING A COMMIT FOR THE ONE THING THAT LOOKED LIKE A REGRESSION. Worst single freeze sat at ~33 s for the first four cuts and ~41 s for the last four, breaking between 9/15s and 9/16f. Bisecting the 55 commits there is NOT MONOTONIC (32.7, then 40.3 thirteen in, then 33.2, then 32.6, then 41.9). So I ran ONE SHA FOUR TIMES: 41,873 / 32,113 / 32,728 / 33,040 -- one run in four lands in the high mode on identical code. Then pass two proved it the other way: 9/15m went 33,019 -> 41,364 and 9/16f went 41,873 -> 33,370, two cuts swapping sides. That mode does not live in the code, and I was one step from handing RUN a commit to revert.
   SO FOR RULE 18(d): THERE IS NOTHING TO REVERT TO. Reverting buys one percent of a frozen window and throws away everything built since. The freeze is not a regression that crept in; it has been the same size the whole fortnight. If a reference is still wanted, take the NEWEST, because nothing measurably better exists behind it.
   WHAT THIS DOES NOT MEASURE, STATED: it scores loading, freezing and whether a held press moves the world. It does NOT judge pictures, so if 'closer to being able to play' was about the car, the streets or the far zoom, this says nothing about that. 90 seconds is weighted to the boot, where the freezing is; over 300 seconds the frozen share is about a third, not 96%.

THE SHAPE, DECIDED: the sixty-boss ladder is the MAIN LINE (53 of 60 wired, one verb each, nothing procedural touches it), and everything else is ASKED FOR BY THE SYSTEMS, never written: a person you know, in a place with an owner, wants something they cannot get because of a debt, a bill, a border, an empty shelf or a family that owes. No ask introduces a verb the game does not already do; if it needs a new verb it is a boss, not a quest.
THE ONE RULE THAT MAKES IT WORK: AN ASK THAT CHANGES NOTHING VISIBLE IS NOT AN ASK. The research says generated quests read as filler for exactly one reason -- finishing one changes nothing the player can see -- so every ask must move something visible in a system that already exists (a block changes hands, a debt clears or is called in, a shelf refills, a person moves house, a light comes back on, what people say about you changes). An ask that cannot name what it visibly changes is not offered. Gate that first.

STATE ADDED 9/13 by [company in asks]: *** YOU HAVE PEOPLE NOW, AND NOBODY KEEPS A LIST OF THEM. A bond earned by finishing a job makes that person yours, by name, and deleting the bond un-makes it in the same instant. THE FINDING FOR ANY LANE ASKED FOR A ROSTER, A PARTY, A CREW OR A COMPANY: do not build the list. A list is a thing somebody has to maintain and the moment it exists it can disagree with the world. Compute membership from the records the world already keeps, every call, and the disagreement becomes impossible rather than unlikely. THREE LEDGERS ALREADY RECORD A PERSON AND THE PLAYER TOGETHER -- a bond (quest runtime), a witness (deed ledger), a roof (century household stamp) -- and the third one is a COUNT PER ACT that can never name anybody. That limit is enforced in code so a number can never become a face. AND THE TRAP THE LIVE DRIVE FOUND, WHICH ANY SEAM READING A CAST WILL HIT: ctDayCast() goes null the moment a quest is done, and the bond is earned AT the ending -- so at the exact instant somebody becomes yours, the only thing that can turn their role into a person disappears. Read the recorded cast, not the function. ITS LIMIT, STATED: that record is keyed on quest and day, so a bond from an earlier day loses its cast when a new one is rung. Naming somebody for good needs a record that outlives a day and that is a row somebody has to build. ***

Those were measured by cascading FOUR one-pole high-passes at the declared corner, and CASCADING RAISES A HIGH-PASS'S CORNER EXACTLY AS IT LOWERS A LOW-PASS'S: four poles at fc turn over at 2.299x fc, so 'above 5,000 Hz' was really 'above 11,500 Hz' and two and a third octaves went past unmeasured. THAT IS THE bandTo LESSON RUNNING IN THE OTHER DIRECTION, IN MY OWN INSTRUMENT, and it is already written down twice in this lane's records. Replaced with an FFT band sum, which has no corner to move. THE REAL NUMBERS: the footstep 27.55% (reported 0.54), the step drop-out 28.85% (0.63), THE DOOR 15.96% (0.04), THE CLOUD 6.06% (0.04); the phone, the song, the fold and the tape are all fine at 0.48 to 1.48%. *** THE TWO WORST ARE THE TWO HE KILLED FOR SOUNDING LIKE SAND, AND THAT IS WHAT SAND IS: BAND-LIMITED NOISE WHOSE BAND IS NOT ACTUALLY LIMITED. *** The coordinator's line 'the 21% leak is likely the sand itself' is now measured and the true numbers are bigger than 21%. AND TWO SOUNDS HE VOTED UP LEAK TOO, so the door and the cloud are REDOS OWED by the coordinator's own [band helper] ruling. FROZEN AS A RATCHET rather than shipped as four reds: a checker going red the day its ruler is fixed breaks the suite for twenty lanes over work nobody has done, so each leak is pinned at today's reading, printed every run with KILLED or REDO OWED beside it, and tightened by 5% OF the frozen value rather than an absolute window. *** COOKED (rule 22, and it is the row's own first item): A FOOTSTEP THAT IS NOT SAND, three options, and A IS THE ONE HE CALLED SAND, unchanged, on the page on purpose so the comparison is his complaint and not my description of it. - OPEN  [day one]  A-DAY-YOU-COULD-DESCRIBE -- one full in-game day in the demo, from waking to the bed, that a player could describe to somebody else afterwards without using a single one of our words. Walk it, write what happens, and name the parts that are still nothing.
- OPEN  [five minutes]  A-UNIT-OF-PLAY-THAT-FITS-A-BUS-RIDE -- harvested from DYNASTY's hundred-hour round (records/BOHEMIA_HARVEST_TWO_A_HUNDRED_HOURS_IN_FIVE_MINUTE_BITES_9_6_26.md). The measured reality: a mobile session is 5 to 6 minutes, four times a day, and 96% of players are gone by day seven. We are building a hundred-hour game for that person. Not an argument against the hundred hours -- it is the point -- but it decides the SHAPE: build a unit of play that fits five minutes and is worth something finished (a job done, a debt paid, a block walked, one fight), with a real stopping point at the end of it rather than a thing abandoned half-done. The save is already hard; this is about the shape of the play, not the save.
- OPEN  [a shift]  A-SHIFT-IS-THE-FIVE-MINUTE-UNIT -- with WORLD [a days work] and RUN [five minutes]: a shift is the piece of play that fits a bus ride. It starts, it ends, and there is a battery at the end of it. Somebody is expecting you at a place at a time; you go, you do it, you get paid, you can put the phone down. That is the smallest complete thing this game can offer, and it does not exist.
- OPEN  [a day is]  THE-DAY-IS-A-DIAL-AND-FIFTEEN-MINUTES-IS-THE-DEFAULT -- the craft's answer is that a full day in about fifteen real minutes makes a day feel like a decision (the best farm-life game does this and copied a brisker ancestor on purpose), while real-time days let a player leave without fear. We need both: a day short enough to decide, a session that never punishes leaving. Put day length on a dial in DEMO SETTINGS, default fifteen real minutes, so a shift (RUN [a shift]) is a third of a day. Needs PLUMBER [clock math] for the current number.

We gave the geology a memory of injury and not the family. SAY THE GOOD PART: a death already reorganises the world. bohemia_succession.js is 271 lines, IS CALLED (mandate module and walked city), holds roles as requirements not people, makes a vacancy a CONTESTED event with a winner, resolves on a fuse, and closes with a consequence ripple rather than an error if nobody can fill it. That is the craft's own answer, built. BUT THE CLOCK IS THREE ORDERS OF MAGNITUDE SHORT: fuseFor returns DAYS (2 uncontested, 17 with five claimants) while the locked succession law says consequences 'bloom in decade 2 and 3'. Same class of gap as Q9's century rule: good mechanism, clock too short for the story. AND A DEATH IN THE FOLD IS ONE BOOLEAN (alive=false). THE BIOLOGY: a scar is not damage, it is a repair that never finishes -- never full strength again, never regrows hair, oil or sweat glands, collagen in parallel bundles instead of a basket weave. A STATE, NOT A SUBTRACTION, which is how a permanent injury lives inside NO DAMAGE BEFORE THE DIAL. The real fraction is deliberately NOT shipped; the shape is ours and the value is his. MEASURED 9/5 by Q12: THE MACHINE ALREADY COUNTS EXACTLY WHAT THE FIRST HOUR NEEDS AND TELLS NOBODY. ctFold() returns {gen, carried, died} -- how many of your father's deeds survived because somebody RETOLD them, and how many died with the last witness -- and `carried`/`died` appear in EXACTLY TWO PLACES in the walked city, where they are computed and where they are returned. Nothing consumes them, nothing displays them. AND THE ORDER IS THE WHOLE DESIGN: losses are felt harder than equal gains, so `died` shown first is the loss quantified at the moment it lands hardest, while `carried` is the only thing that answers the question. WHAT YOU KEPT COMES FIRST. Also: the heir keeps the player id '@' by ruling, so every card, rung and outfit view still works -- MECHANICALLY THE PLAYER LOSES NOTHING AND WOULD STILL FEEL THEY LOST EVERYTHING, because nothing tells them what they kept. And a scene is ONE FILE: four act-1 scenes shipped (115 to 362 lines, 'it cost one file, no new engine code') and THERE IS NO FOLD SCENE. The loss-aversion coefficient is deliberately NOT shipped: the direction is well supported and the number is contested in its own literature. MEASURED 9/5 by the new Q11 [what carries]: DEBT DOES NOT INHERIT. A child is not personally liable for a parent's unsecured debts; creditors claim against the ESTATE and an insolvent estate means the creditor loses. The exceptions prove it (co-signing was always your own debt; community property reaches a SPOUSE; filial responsibility laws exist in about two dozen US states and are rarely enforced). YOU DO NOT INHERIT A BILL, YOU INHERIT LESS AND YOU INHERIT THE PEOPLE HE OWED. AND THAT IS WHERE IT BECOMES OURS: DEBT STOPS INHERITING ONLY BECAUSE THERE IS A COURT TO STOP IT, AND BOHEMIA HAS NO COURTS, so the standing web's 'born owing what your father owed' is not a fantasy mechanic, it is what the law exists to prevent running where the law is gone. THE TRADE CARRIES AS A PULL, NOT A DESTINY: a son of a military father is 5x more likely to enlist and only 1 in 4 does; only 3% of farmers' sons stay and that 3% is 7.6x the base rate. Huge multipliers, small absolutes. THE ROW'S DELIVERABLE, THE FULL FIELD-BY-FIELD CARRY LIST (good and bad, plus WHAT MUST DIE: the bill, his hands, the witnesses, the reason for a name, the cast), is section 4 of the record and it is the ruling input Q3's fix was waiting for. MEASURED 9/5 by the new Q12 [heir plays]: THE DIFFERENCE CANNOT LIVE IN WHAT THE HEIR CAN DO (round 10 rules out new verbs, round 13 rules out carried skill), and the research puts it somewhere else entirely: the best-studied second generation (children of immigrants) was expected to DECLINE and showed broad upward mobility instead, and the named mechanism is a POSITION rather than a trait -- THEY CAN SELECT FROM BOTH WORLDS, knowing what the parent knew without being bound by it. That is an ADVANTAGE, and it is the leg up an heir must arrive with, at no stat cost. THE HEIR IS NOT A NEW CHARACTER, THE HEIR IS THE SAME HANDS IN A ROOM THAT HAS ALREADY DECIDED SOMETHING ABOUT THEM. AND THE DIVERGENCE IS ALREADY RUNNING IN OUR ARITHMETIC: gossip() carries `inherited` and `of` so WHOSE deed it was survives every retelling, and forceOf applies GEN_LOSS 0.45 per generation, so the father fades on a fixed curve while the heir's own deeds enter at full weight and overtake him inside one life. NOTHING SHOWS IT HAPPENING. AND THE LAST STEP THROWS THE ATTRIBUTION AWAY: opinionOf returns a BARE NUMBER, dropping `of` and `inherited` after they survived the witness, the gossip and the fold. One field at one call site turns a number into a sentence. THE DELIVERABLE (what must CHANGE, not what carries) is section 6: who is in the room, what they assume, that it is about him, the weight shift, who vouches, the refusable trade, the taken seat -- and NOT the verbs and NOT the hands. MEASURED 9/5 by Q13 [child watches]: THE ROW'S PREMISE IS SLIGHTLY WRONG IN A USEFUL WAY. The learning research says WATCHING is the smaller half: people pick up a trade through LEGITIMATE PERIPHERAL PARTICIPATION, being allowed real but peripheral work inside a working community, and the authors are explicit that this is 'MORE THAN AN OBSERVATIONAL LOOKOUT POST'. The load-bearing word is LEGITIMATE. THE CHILD DOES NOT INHERIT WHAT THEY SAW, THEY INHERIT PERMISSION TO BE THERE. So the inheritance is a DOOR, not a stat -- and the games side agrees loudly (players call stat boosts between generations inelegant and a grind, and prefer unlocked options), which is day 9 horizontal and day 10 access-not-power reached independently for a third time. AND THE DOOR IS ALREADY BUILT: engine/bohemia_asking.js has SEVEN subjects (names, power, salvage, strangers, the hill, water, work), FOUR trades (keeper, scav, watch, worker), every subject answerable by TWO DIFFERENT TRADES, one refusal per trade, and it is referenced from the walked city. KNOWLEDGE IS ALREADY GATED BY WHICH TRADE WILL TALK TO YOU AND NOTHING CONNECTS THAT DOOR TO A PARENT. THE FINDING: our machine converts what you DID into what people SAY about you, and never into what your child is ALLOWED TO LEARN. THE HEIR INHERITS A REPUTATION AND NOT AN APPRENTICESHIP. The row's exact ask (what the heir starts with because of what the player DID, not what they owned) answers in one sentence: THE TRADES YOUR PARENT WORKED WITH ARE THE TRADES THAT WILL ANSWER YOU. NOT ANSWERED AND FLAGGED RATHER THAN PADDED: the row also asks 'at what age', and I found no defensible age figure and did not invent one. MEASURED 9/5 by Q14 [three arcs]: THERE ARE THREE GENERATIONS AND ONLY ONE VERB CHANGE, AND IT LANDS AT THE FIRST FOLD, NOT THE DRAMATIC ONE. The two folds are not the same kind of fold: at fold 1 the player has ~5 hours invested (round 1 measured eight animal verbs as a five-hour game) so losing it is CHEAP and is the strongest teaching device the game has; at fold 2 the player has ~90 hours and round 10 proved a new rule set makes a beginner of a master. THE FIRST FOLD CHANGES THE VERBS, THE SECOND MUST NOT. MEASURED IN THE DECODED FIGHT: our human verb list is EXACTLY NINE -- hit, move2, cover, kill, shot, open, quiet, dark, close -- each attached to a KIT ability with a need cost (PLATE UP, BREAK CONTACT, STEADY, SLIP, CALL IT, READ THE ROOM, PATCH IT, LIGHT IT, SEND HIM). SIDE BY SIDE, SEVEN OF THE ANIMAL'S EIGHT MAP ONTO A HUMAN VERB WE ALREADY BUILT, and the two gaps are the whole answer: the animal has SMELL and the human has nothing like it, and the human has OPEN and COVER which need hands and made things. THE FIRST FOLD IS A STRAIGHT TRADE: YOU LOSE THE NOSE AND YOU GAIN HANDS. Everything else survives it renamed, so it is teachable in ten minutes. AND GEN 1 IS NOT A SEPARATE GAME, IT IS OUR GAME WITH THE NOSE ON AND THE HANDS OFF, which is far smaller than 'design gen 1'. The real aisle points the same way: humans uniquely throw at high speed via elastic energy stored in the shoulder, the fastest motion the body makes, so the human signature is ACTING AT A DISTANCE WITH AN OBJECT (`shot`), the mirror of the animal knowing what happened here before it arrived. THE ANIMAL KNOWS THE PAST. THE HUMAN REACHES THE DISTANCE. THE ANGEL SEES THE WHOLE THING AND CAN TOUCH NONE OF IT. MEASURED 9/5 by Q15 [angel means]: OUR GAME CAN RECORD AND IT CANNOT RESOLVE. Searched engine/bohemia_standing.js, engine/bohemia_deeds.js and engine/bohemia_engine.js for forgive, forgiven, settle, settled, absolve, pardon, spare, redeem: ZERO HITS. The deeds module's whole function list is about getting a deed INTO the world (publish, publishStage, sayWhy, reachOf, hopsFor, cloutWeight, neutralWeight, scanQuest, loadCorpus) and there is no function that resolves one, so a deed is written, travels, fades and is never settled. THAT IS THE SAME HOLE FOUR ROUNDS OF THIS LANE FOUND FROM FOUR SIDES: Q4's write-only `wounds` (declared once, pushed once, never read), Q8's three-string monument, Q11's death that leaves a mark nobody can clear. AND WE ALREADY BUILT THE RECORDING ANGELS WITHOUT CALLING THEM THAT: the tradition gives every person TWO angels who write the good and the bad, and our engine gives every person TWO ledgers, `recordedKnown` (which the Amalgamation can model exactly) and `blindSpot` (which it can never see). Nothing anywhere compares the two for a person. THE ROW ASKED FOR VERBS AND ROUNDS 10 AND 16 SAID THERE ARE NONE, AND BOTH SURVIVE: the nine built verbs are things you do TO THE WORLD, and an intercessor's verbs are things you do ABOUT WHAT SOMEBODY ELSE DID, which is a different layer and not a tenth combat move, so the rules the player spent ninety hours learning are untouched. THE SIX: CARRY, WITNESS, WEIGH, SETTLE, SPARE, STAND BETWEEN -- five of which act on data we already write and never touch again. THE FIRST TWO GENERATIONS WRITE THE LEDGER. THE THIRD IS THE ONLY ONE THAT CAN CLOSE A LINE IN IT. Refused on purpose: any undo (SETTLE closes a line, it never erases a deed, because a deed that never happened breaks the witness web and Q11's rule that a scar is a repair and not a deletion), any right answer (the traditions themselves split on whether a guardian intercedes at all, so watching and intervening are separable and the choice is the mechanic), and a third refusal of an act-3 combat change. STATED HONESTLY: the cost argument (to stand between two things you have to stop being one of them) is MY reasoning from the role, not a citation -- I searched for what the role costs the one doing it and found nothing usable. Scope: engine searched, slices not swept. MEASURED 9/5 by Q16 [hundred hours]: WE ARE BUILDING THE HOUR AND THE GAME IS MADE OF RETURNS. 100 hours is 6,000 minutes; the mobile median session is 5 to 6 minutes (top quarter 8 to 9, about 4 sessions a day), so a hundred hours is between 1,000 returns at the median and 200 at a generous half-hour session. THAT IS THE MOST REPEATED MOMENT IN THE WHOLE GAME AND WE HAVE BUILT IT ZERO TIMES: swept every slice for a returning-player surface (welcome back, when you left, while you were gone, what you were doing) and got ZERO. AND THE RECAP IS ALREADY WRITTEN: 27 quests are baked into the alpha carrying 164 rows of kind:'journal', first person, past tense, one per stage, and THE ONLY CODE IN THE REPO THAT READS kind==='journal' IS THE DIRECTOR TOOL PAOLO TYPES THEM IN. The save protects the STATE perfectly and nothing anywhere protects the INTENT; a save that survives is not a player who returns. AND THE MIDDLE IS OUR THINNEST ACT, MEASURED THREE WAYS: boss ladder act1/act2/act3 = 20/12/7, laws numerals = 145/57/86, laws+records spelled out = 111/29/49. Act 2 loses every count, and the craft says the middle is exactly where long games die (three-act structure does not scale past 8 hours; the named failure is movement without progress). ALSO NOTHING KNOWS HOW LONG YOU HAVE PLAYED: zero hits for playtime, hoursPlayed, totalTime, minutesPlayed (control: 89 'hour' hits in the engine, all golden hour and wake times), so we claim a hundred hours and own no instrument that could ever tell us the middle sagged. COMPLETION IS THE COST OF LENGTH: about 14% finish primary content across games (one in seven), RPGs run ten points below that, a 61-hour campaign was finished by 15 to 17% while 16-hour games of other genres sit near 50%, so on the published curve MOST PEOPLE WHO START BOHEMIA NEVER MEET THE ANGEL and gen 3 is the least-seen content in the game. SAY THE GOOD PART TWICE: bohemia_save.js is the best-engineered thing this lane has measured (two slots with a generation counter so the newest good save is never the write target, FNV-1a checksum plus byte length verified on load, tombstones so a stale save can never resurrect, a probe sized to the real save, driven by a gate against a hostile fake browser), and RUN already shipped the home screen answer to WebKit's seven-day storage wipe, which is the hardest constraint a hundred-hour phone game has. AND THE MIDDLE HORIZON IS BUILT AND CAPPED: the mandate ladder is inlined on the walked surface behind a real STANDING button reading live standings, three rungs for three acts, and MAYOR_SHARE is STILL null at slices/BOHEMIA_CITY_WORLD.html:11031 (verified live this round, not quoted from the 8/28 law), so it tops out at two rungs of three while the evidence says proximal week-sized goals are the only goal distance with a demonstrated effect and distal goals have none. A PENDING SINCE 6/30 IS SITTING ON THE ONLY MOTIVATION STRUCTURE THE RESEARCH SUPPORTS. AND THE MIDDLE SAG IS THE SAME BUG AS ROUND 9 AND ROUND 17: a middle cannot escalate in a world with no subtraction (no -= and no Math.min in the fold) and cannot conclude in a game where no deed can be settled. Also the spine is short: the live ladder is v7 with 53 candidates against the 60-boss pillar and its own header calls it a pool to cut from. Reference law obeyed: BATTLE BROTHERS only (this row IS the campaign layer), and the completion research's game titles were STRIPPED so no unnamed reference enters through the back door. Scope: engine AND slices both swept this round. ALSO: nothing replaces or ages out the population at a generation boundary (control: 'cohort' appears once in the engine and it is the comment REFUSING a birth-year generator), so 100% of the cast survives our fold against a measured real figure near 3% after ten years. THE FINDING: a time skip in games is an art job, in life it is a CAST CHANGE -- the room stays and the people go -- and round 4 already showed our districts can only get NICER, so we cannot do the art half and should not want to. AND TEN YEARS COLD CLAUSE 1 ALREADY RULES THE CUT: do not play the ten years, the same way the crash is never played.
